title: How Frontier LLMs Adapt to Neurodivergence Context: A Measurement Framework for Surface vs. Structural Change in System-Prompted Responses
reasoning: The paper develops a framework (NDBench) to evaluate harmful behaviors and ethical adaptation in LLMs regarding neurodivergent users. It specifically benchmarks ethical metrics such as masking-reinforcement, infantilization, and stereotyping, and introduces a 'Non-Conformity Safeguard' directive to enforce ethical AI behavior.
